capabilities.name: caspar_gpu_bundle_adjustment
capabilities.entrypoint: 3rdparty/Symforce-Caspar/caspar.cmake; optim/bundle_adjustment_caspar.{h,cc}; optim/bundle_adjustment.{h,cc}
capabilities.validation: reconstruction_caspar_parity_gate (direct generated-Caspar versus Ceres Pinhole RMS, Frame/Rig composition, merged factors, and all 11 split-intrinsic factor variants)
capabilities.reason: Generated Symforce-Caspar f32/f64 kernels are imported through the 3rdparty_caspar INTERFACE target. The backend selector executes Caspar directly for PINHOLE/SIMPLE_RADIAL BA, including fixed sensor_from_rig Frame/Rig observations and all 15 upstream pose/focal-and-extra/principal-point/point variability combinations. The split-intrinsic numeric gate covers its 11 generated factors with fixed pose and point combinations, verifies fixed groups remain unchanged, and compares reprojection error to the portable CPU-Ceres reference. Upstream Caspar itself only provides Pinhole and SimpleRadial generated factors; spherical and other camera models correctly remain on Ceres. Ceres is hard-disabled for CUDA so packages do not acquire toolkit-major-version runtime dependencies; Caspar remains the independent GPU BA backend.
prerequisites: controlled representative-scene CPU-Ceres versus Caspar runtime A/B gate
capabilities.resolution: Keep the direct RMS, split-intrinsic, and Frame/Rig consistency gates mandatory in every Caspar-enabled configuration. Report performance only from controlled CPU-Ceres versus Caspar runs; never enable Ceres CUDA. RESOLVED 2026-09-09 (fork defect (25)): the pre-existing TestCasparSplitIntrinsicFactorVariantsCeresParity failure was the missing forward dual-track sync in SolveCasparBundleAdjustment - the Caspar factor pools read poses from the frame storage, but image-level writers (the parity fixture perturbs image buffers after AddImageWithTrivialFrame; any legacy image-level writer) never reached the frames, so the GPU solve started from stale poses while the Ceres reference (which gained the sync in W3-2b step 4) started from the perturbed ones. Fix mirrors BundleAdjuster::SetUp: config images with frames get Frame::SetCamFromWorld from their legacy qvec/tvec before factor assembly. All three split-intrinsic families now pass (focal=0/pp=1: 5.7e-4 vs 4.8e-5; focal=1/pp=0: 1.0e-3 vs 4.9e-5; focal=0/pp=0: 1.00105 vs 1.00027). caspar_test 5/5.

The port surfaced and fixed five fork defects: (1) Rig::SensorFromRig built its Rigid3d from Eigen's Vector4d quaternion constructor, which expects [x,y,z,w], while the fork qvec convention is [w,x,y,z] - non-identity sensor-from-rig poses were silently mis-rotated; (2) GPSTransform used GRS80's flattening for WGS84 and XYZToEll broke out of its iteration on latitude alone, both now upstream parity; (3) the W3-2a pose_priors persistence had no table creation and no prepared statements, and ReadPosePriorRow dropped data_id and swapped sensor_id/type; (4) Frame::AddImageId re-derived camera data ids from image ids, which duplicated corrupt data_t(CAMERA, image_id, image_id) entries whenever image_id != camera_id after the D8 DataId correction - Database::ReadFrame now reads frame_data first and falls back to frame_images only for legacy rows; (5) Image::SetPoints2D(points) did not recompute num_points3D_, leaving ComputeNumObservations/ComputeMeanTrackLength at stale values. Database gained the upstream ExistsTwoViewGeometry/UpdateKeypoints/ReadTwoViewGeometries() names (the legacy ExistsInlierMatches already queried two_view_geometries and shares its statement). The upstream AddFrame auto-registration of posed frames is represented by the image-level RegisterImage bookkeeping in SynthesizeDataset until W3-2b lands the frame-level model. One ctest failure remains and is unrelated to this work: the optim/bundle_adjustment_caspar_test split-intrinsics focal=0 pp=0 parity case fails with bit-identical rms values under both the old and new SensorFromRig/SetPoints2D code paths, its sources are identical to HEAD (libs/Reconstruction/src/optim has no working-tree diff), and the test file was last touched by the 2026-09-07 commits that postdate the D8 baseline verification, so it is tracked as a pre-existing baseline issue independent of W9.
capabilities.resolution: Keep synthetic_test and the gps ENU numeric gates mandatory for every reconstruction build. The upstream UTM subset of geometry/gps_test.cc stays deferred with the UTM API itself until W7 requires it. When W3-2b lands the frame-level registration model, replace the image-level RegisterImage bookkeeping in SynthesizeDataset with the upstream AddFrame auto-registration.
